routing_warnings.description: The specific AI-workflow scaffolding, turnaround-time concern, and AI-detection findings concern the original-authorship and limited-AI Requirement rather than execution of question-set curation.
The missing book-wide note may be failure evidence for the separately defined global-perspective Requirement, subject to confirming that the referenced note is the required US/India framing note.
The completed four-layer sample was delivered as the pre-project writing test and does not establish implementation of the full manuscript answer-layer Requirement.
The suggestion-mode and editorial-comment instructions concern curation of the existing question set rather than the answer-layer structure.

The client's findings about AI-assisted content and insufficient original professional judgment are execution evidence for the original-authorship Requirement, while the project-termination clause supports removal of the target chapter Requirement.

The findings about AI-workflow scaffolding, rapid turnaround, AI-detection results, and insufficient original work support an execution failure for the authorship requirement; under this target they support only the project-wide removal.
The clause requiring a brief framing note at the beginning is independently represented by the introductory-note Requirement rather than the cross-cutting global-perspective Requirement.
The observed absence of the referenced book-wide note is a runtime failure of the introductory-note Requirement, not evidence that the cross-cutting global perspective itself was absent.
The AI-workflow scaffolding, rapid turnaround, AI-detection results, and lack of original analysis concern the original-authorship Requirement rather than this target.
